endings.title: The Dark Council
endings.text: The Jedi win, then take the Republic for themselves. The vision did not come true. Something worse did.

endings.title: Dawn Unbroken
endings.text: The Sith are exposed and arrested. Every clone is freed from the chips. The vision is sealed in the Archive, unfulfilled.

endings.title: The Vision Fades
endings.text: Bane died at Ruusan. No Sith line came after him. The war ends in a hard, uneasy peace.

endings.title: The Long Exile
endings.text: The Order escapes before the command comes. The Temple stands empty. Far from Coruscant, the Jedi begin again.

endings.title: Grey Peace
endings.text: The Sith fall. Some clones still carry the chips. Peace holds with a weapon left in the room.

endings.title: The Fire
endings.text: The vision comes true. The Order is lost in the fire. The names of the fallen enter the Archive of Legends.
